diff --git a/src/itsdangerous/timed.py b/src/itsdangerous/timed.py
index 3599a7e..fd51a86 100644
--- a/src/itsdangerous/timed.py
+++ b/src/itsdangerous/timed.py
@@ -123,13 +123,21 @@ class TimedSerializer(Serializer):
         raised. All arguments are forwarded to the signer's
         :meth:`~TimestampSigner.unsign` method.
         """
-        base64d, timestamp = self.make_signer(salt).unsign(
-            s, max_age, return_timestamp=True
-        )
-        payload = self.load_payload(base64d)
-        if return_timestamp:
-            return payload, timestamp
-        return payload
+        s = want_bytes(s)
+        last_exception = None
+        for signer in self.iter_unsigners(salt):
+            try:
+                base64d, timestamp = signer.unsign(s, max_age, return_timestamp=True)
+            except SignatureExpired:
+                raise
+            except BadSignature as err:
+                last_exception = err
+                continue
+            payload = self.load_payload(base64d)
+            if return_timestamp:
+                return payload, timestamp
+            return payload
+        raise last_exception
 
     def loads_unsafe(self, s, max_age=None, salt=None):
         load_kwargs = {"max_age": max_age}

@@ -84,3 +85,15 @@ class TestTimedSerializer(FreezeMixin, TestSerializer):
     def test_return_payload(self, serializer, value, ts):

+
+    def test_fallback_signers(self, value):
+        serializer = TimedSerializer(
+            secret_key="secret_key", signer_kwargs={"digest_method": hashlib.sha512}
+        )
+        signed = serializer.dumps(value)
+        fallback_serializer = TimedSerializer(
+            secret_key="secret_key",
+            signer_kwargs={"digest_method": hashlib.sha1},
+            fallback_signers=[{"digest_method": hashlib.sha512}],
+        )
+        assert fallback_serializer.loads(signed) == value
